hxslider.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit slider control API.

The slider supports the following list of user input events: left/right arrow: moves the head by a page amount wheel: moves the head by a page amount dragging the head: user can reposition the head freely clicking left/right of the head: moves the head by a page amount

HxResult HxSliderAlternateDraw ( HxSlider_t *  pSlider,
HxSliderDrawFunction  pDrawFunction 
)

Set an alternate drawing mechanism.

Assigning an alternate draw function allows you to implement your own custom drawing routine for the slider. The head is still drawn by the slider, however the body can be overridden by the user.

Parameters:
pSlider IN: Pointer to a slider
pDrawFunction IN: Drawing function to use
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxSliderDelete ( HxSlider_t *  pSlider  ) 

Delete a slider widget.

This function deletes a slider created from an earlier call to HxSliderNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxSliderDelete only needs to be called when removing a slider at runtime.

Parameters:
pSlider IN: Pointer to the slider to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

Create a slider control widget.

This function creates a new slider control widget.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing button
initialValue IN: Initial value for the slider
minValue IN: Minimum value for the slider
maxValue IN: Maximum value for the slider
pageSize IN: Increment value for each slider click
x IN: x coordinate for the top left button origin
y IN: y coordinate for the top left button origin
inlineSize IN: if horiz then represents width, if vert height
attr IN: attributes of the slider (i.e. vert, horiz ...)
numTicks IN: Number of ticks to display
hSlider OUT: Handle to the new slider; *hSlider is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails, and sets *hSlider to NULL.

HxResult HxSliderSetPosition ( HxSlider_t *  pSlider,
int32_t  position 
)

Set the position of a slider widget.

This function sets the position of the slider.

If the slider's position is bounded by its min and max value. If the position argument is not within that range, the min or max value is used, and no error is returned.

Parameters:
pSlider IN: Pointer to a slider
position IN: Position to set the slider to.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
